preprocessing_steps.Description: lowpass filter, downsampling, baseline correction, artifact rejection

Bandpass.Order: passband up to 40 Hz, stopband starting at 49 Hz

TaskDescription: [spelling] RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) BCI speller where 30 symbols are presented one-by-one in random order at the center of the screen. Three conditions tested: NoColor 116ms SOA, Color 116ms SOA, and Color 83ms SOA. Colors used to facilitate discrimination. Trial duration: 46.5s, SOA: 116.0ms.
Instructions: Participants fixate center of screen, concentrate on target letter, silently count its occurrences. Avoid blinking during visual presentation.
